name: ptee-windows-limitations
title: Windows limitations: when a policy doesn't survive HNS
summary: The HNS dataplane cannot express every Calico rule. Rules it can't render are silently dropped - and a dropped Deny is a security hole. Load a negated Deny, watch it vanish from the Windows (HNS) tab, and learn the four divergences that matter when you author policy for a mixed cluster.
